title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-PYPDF-15989793 in pypdf@6.9.2
description:
## XML Entity Expansion

**Severity:** medium
**Package:** pypdf@6.9.2
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 6.9  
**Exploit Maturity:** proof-of-concept  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 738/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2026-40260](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40260)

**Fix:** Upgrade `pypdf` to version 6.10.0 or later.

### Details
## Overview
[pypdf](https://pypi.org/project/pypdf) is an A pure-python PDF library capable of splitting, merging, cropping, and transforming PDF files

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to XML Entity Expansion when parsing XMP metadata. An attacker can cause excessive memory consumption with excessive DOCTYPE entity declarations.
## Remediation
Upgrade `pypdf` to version 6.10.0 or higher.
## References
- [GitHub Advisory](https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf/security/advisories/GHSA-3crg-w4f6-42mx)
- [GitHub Commit](https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf/commit/b15a374e5ca648d4878e57c3b2c0551e7f8cc7f8)
- [GitHub PR](https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf/pull/3724)
- [GitHub Release](https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf/releases/tag/6.10.0)
